frame_aggregation: For each of the 48 physical chessboard corners, 50 repeated image observations were aggregated. The median undistorted pixel coordinate is used as the formal E3 image observation.
purpose: The aggregation removes repeated-frame sampling from the calibration-design experiment so that E3 primarily measures sensitivity to calibration point quantity and spatial distribution.
important_statistical_note: The 50 frames are repeated visual observations of one physical setup and are not treated as 50 independent physical experiments.
